collar_tag_req: Upon payment of the tag fee in full, the Dog Licence Permit Issuer shall provide the owner with a dog tag... The owner shall keep the dog tag securely fastened on the dog at all times until Animal Control By-Law Page 3.
dog_limit: No explicit per-household limit mentioned for non-kennels, but commercial and hobby kennels are subject to an annual licensing fee.
notes: Guide dogs actively in use are exempt from the Poop & Scoop requirements. No specific exemptions or definitions for livestock guardian dogs. URL: https://www.tayvalleytwp.ca/media/lkpd5ymf/by-law-no-2001-050-animal-control-by-law.pdf

collar_tag_req: The License shall be taken out by the owner who is issued a dog tag, which shall be valid for the lifetime of the individual dog for which the license was originally obtained. The owner shall keep the tag securely fixed on the dog at all times.
dog_limit: No owner or owners living at the same address shall keep more than 5 (five) dogs in any one household over the age of twelve weeks.
notes: Any person in the Township of Strong may kill any dog that is found killing or injuring livestock, poultry, or other domestic animals or straying upon premises where livestock or poultry are kept. URL: https://www.strongtownship.com/media/0n1klj3m/dog-by-law-2016-009_fee-update-2021_amended-2021.pdf

herding_definition: “Herding Dog” means a dog that has been trained and is actively being used in a bona fide farming operation for the purposed of controlling livestock on the farm.
collar_tag_req: Upon the applicant providing all information and documentation required, and paying the appropriate registration fee, the Dog or Cat shall be registered, and shall be issued a Dog Tag or Cat Tag... No personal shall attach a Tag to a Dog or Cat other than the Dog or Cat for which it was issued.
notes: The municipality's registration process specifically requires owners to 'Disclose if the Dog is a Livestock Guardian Dog, or a Herding Dog'. Shared by-law frameworks in the region (e.g. Cobalt By-law 2013-037) officially define Herding Dogs and Livestock Guardian Dogs. URL: https://www.temiskamingshores.ca/living-here/animal-control/

collar_tag_req: The owner shall attach the tag to the dog and ensure that it remains attached to the dog at all times.
dog_limit: A maximum of three (3) dogs allowed per each residential lot.
notes: The by-law defines a 'Work Dog' simply as a 'Male dog or spayed female' and states that Work dogs must be kept under restraint at all times, making it a generic classification rather than an agricultural/livestock exemption. URL: https://temagamifirstnation.ca/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/Dog-By-Law-002.pdf

collar_tag_req: Upon Registration of the of a dog or Dangerous Dog, each owner shall receive a permanent dog tag. Every owner of a dog shall keep the dog tag securely fixed on the dog at all times.
dog_limit: A maximum of 3 dogs are permitted for each dwelling.
notes: Amended by By-law 62-2024 to regulate Doggy Day Cares and Boarding, but standard limit of 3 dogs applies. No agricultural LGD definitions. URL: https://www.thamescentre.on.ca/media/jlpjynyq/dogregistration-september2024.pdf

collar_tag_req: All dogs must be licensed and every licence shall be valid for one calendar year... The tag shall be for the current calendar year.
dog_limit: No person shall operate a kennel without obtaining a license... “Kennel” means a place where more than three dogs are kept and cared for.
notes: Includes standard 'Mitigating Factor' clauses for dogs acting in defense of property/livestock, but lacks explicit LGD definitions. URL: https://www.trentlakes.ca/media/kdjdtaxm/b2023-064-dogs-and-kennels.pdf

collar_tag_req: The owner of a dog shall: a) keep the dog tag securely affixed on the dog for which it was issued at all times until renewed or replaced but the tag may be removed while the dog is being lawfully used for hunting in the bush.
dog_limit: No person shall keep or allow to be kept on a single property in the municipality, more than six dogs unless a Commercial Kennel Permit has been issued.
notes: The municipality allows a higher base limit (6 dogs per property) before a Commercial Kennel permit is required compared to typical 3-dog limits, which provides rural flexibility, but there is no explicit LGD definition. URL: https://tudorandcashel.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/2003-0014-Dog-License-By-law.pdf

collar_tag_req: Every owner of a dog shall cause a dog tag to be securely affixed on the dog at all times (until the tag needs replaced). The tag shall be supplied by the Municipality.
dog_limit: No owner shall keep or permit to be kept more than three (3) dogs at any one time, per dwelling unit... In order to qualify [for an exemption/variance] the dog owner must hold a valid farm registration number registered with the Municipality.
notes: While lacking a specific LGD definition, the by-law mentions holding a 'valid farm registration number registered with the Municipality' as a qualifying factor, implying exemptions to the 3-dog limit or standard rules for legitimate farms. It also exempts hunting dogs actively engaged in hunting on unposted land from 'running at large' provisions. URL: https://tyendinagatownship.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/04-2022-Dog-Control-By-law-Set-Fines-Included.pdf

collar_tag_req: You are required to purchase an animal licence if you own a dog or cat... The number on the dog tag license will assist someone in returning your lost dog.
dog_limit: Residents are permitted to keep up to three (3) dogs on their premises, unless the property is zoned to permit a Licensed Kennel.
notes: Standard urban animal control bylaw. No explicit agricultural or LGD exemptions mentioned. URL: https://www.wawa.cc/your-government/by-laws/

collar_tag_req: No owner shall fail to affix to his or her dog the tag issued... and shall keep such tag affixed on the dog at all times until a tag for the next year is purchased and affixed.
notes: By-law includes exemptions for registered seeing-eye dogs and hearing-ear dogs (no fee), but it is a standard urban by-law with no mention of farm dogs or LGDs. URL: https://www.wasagabeach.com/media/1msostnl/animal-control-by-law.pdf
